item.title: I graded 36 popular MCP servers on agent usability. A third got a D or F
item.description:
📝 Your schema generator is quietly stripping the single most important signal your tools have. The archived Slack reference server — code nobody maintains — scores A/97, because someone once documented every tool and every parameter by hand. Cost: pennies per server on a small model.
🔗 Read more: https://tengli.dev/posts/mcp-servers-failing-agents.html
